_meta.description: Simulated internal client-liability ledger. In production this comes from NetSuite General Ledger saved searches. Paired with fixtures/wallet_data.json to exercise every branch of the Policy Outcome Decision Matrix.
_meta.production_target: NetSuite General Ledger — Saved Search API
_meta.fixture_design_principle: Paired with wallet_data.json to produce ratios calibrated to Kraken's Dec 2025 PoR for anchored assets, and to produce specific control-path violations for synthetic anomalies.

ledger._scenario: Paired with wallet 167690.25 produces ratio 1.003 — calibrated to Kraken's Dec 2025 published 100.3% BTC ratio.
Paired with wallet 2884112 produces ratio 1.013 — calibrated to Kraken's Dec 2025 published 101.3% ETH ratio.
Exact match — wallet equals ledger. Clean ALLOW baseline.

Wallet exceeds ledger by $67,890.50. Ratio 1.0000549 within stablecoin band [1.0000, 1.0500]; the surplus is above the USDT materiality threshold of $10,000, but FAO-REC-002 stablecoin USD materiality applies to a shortfall only (owner decision 2026-11-08), so the outcome is ALLOW.
Ledger claims 9.2M SOL in client liabilities but wallet only holds 8.74M — under-reserved at 95% ratio, below the 1.00 floor. RESERVE RATIO BREACH triggering FAO-REC-004.
Paired with wallet 128265000 produces ratio 1.006 — calibrated to Kraken's Dec 2025 published 100.6% XRP ratio.

NEGATIVE ledger liability injected. Real cause could be a refund batch not yet offset, or a data error. Per Kraken's 2014 krakendb note, any large negative value at a leaf requires investigation. FAO-REC-007 triggers.
